data.desc: Senseonics Holdings, Inc. ('Senseonics') is a diabetes company redefining continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) with long-term implantable sensing technology. Driven by a mission to transform lives in the diabetes community, Senseonics is the maker of Eversense 365, the world's first and only one-year CGM system, and is advancing a differentiated pipeline of innovation. By commercializing Eversense 365 and pushing the boundaries of sensing technology, Senseonics is empowering better diabetes management, reducing the device burden, expanding patient choice, and shaping the future of diabetes care.
